# Fixtures whose check writes a library an earlier check loaded, or reports
# what a check against a fresh library does not. TestLibraryShared keeps it
# exact; rewrite it with -update.
check_basics: writes the library
checker_methods: writes the library
component_override_body_func_imported_base: writes the library
error_component_override_body_func_qualified_base: writes the library
test_receiver_param: writes the library
test_type_methods: writes the library
